none: PAS FindID 973938: Lin-7584B6: Constantine nummus dating AD 348-350
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn copper-alloy Roman nummus of the house of Constantine, dated AD 348-350. Obverse depicts the Emperor, looking right, wearing a laurel crown with ties flowing behind his head. The Emperor's toga is clear to see at his throat. Reverse side is worn and difficult to make out, however it does depict the Emperor in a galley holding a standard (now Christian) in his left hand with his right arm…
